jobs.description_text:
About PhonePe Limited: 

 Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore. 

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode - hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.

 Culture: 

 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

 Why PhonePe: 

 At PhonePe our vision is to provide financial inclusion to a billion Indians. Today we have made significant progress on this vision by making digital payments far simpler and ubiquitous than it has ever been. However we wish to make it so easy, safe, and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. And not just in Urban India. At PhonePe, our aim to transform the entire Indian landscape so that every Indian, in every corner of the country, makes significant economic progress. Onwards and upwards! That is our goal.

 Why PhonePe Design: 

 If you are sold on the vision of the company, you may want to consider the design team as a place to make this a reality. The design team at PhonePe is a bunch of creative trailblazers who are leading the effort to make a dent in the fintech universe. The design team consists of Product Designers, Visual Designers, Graphic & Motion Designers, and Illustrators who are all engaged in blending art and science into a promising value proposition for our users.

 About Share.Market 

 Share.Market is how PhonePe is rebuilding trading and investing for India. It's a full-stack broking platform — stocks, F&O, ETFs, mutual funds, IPOs, and WealthBaskets — with a research and intelligence layer (factor analysis on every stock, expert-curated baskets) sitting on top. It's a separate app from the main PhonePe one, and it's backed by PhonePe's reach, trust, and distribution.

 This is a hard, interesting design problem. You're working with regulated financial products, real money, and a spectrum of users that runs from a first-time investor buying their first stock to an active trader running F&O strategies. The job is to make something genuinely powerful feel calm and trustworthy — not to bolt more features onto a busy screen.

 The role 

 You'll own design for Share.Market end to end. Today that means you, the craft, and a close partnership with product and engineering — this is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-a-distance one. As the product grows, you'll build and lead the team around it.

 You'll set the design direction, ship the work yourself when it matters, and be the person accountable for the quality of the experience. You'll report to the Head of Design (PhonePe Group) and work alongside the broader PhonePe design org, but Share.Market's design is yours to own.

 What you'll do 

• Own the experience. Set the bar for what good looks like on Share.Market, and hold it. Strategy, flows, visual craft, microcopy — you're accountable for all of it.

• Ship, don't just direct. Get into the file. Design the hard screens yourself. Prototype to find the answer rather than arguing about it in a doc.

• Make complex things simple. Turn dense financial data and regulated flows into something a first-time investor trusts and a serious trader respects. This is the core craft of the job.

• Partner closely. Work shoulder to shoulder with product and engineering as an equal. Bring the user's point of view to roadmap and tradeoff conversations early, not at the end.

• Build the team. As Share.Market grows, manage and grow the designers around you, and set the standards they'll work to.

 What we're looking for 

• 12+ years in product design , with real ownership of consumer products at scale. Some of that as a lead, whether managing people or anchoring quality for a product.

• Proven craft. A portfolio that shows depth, not just breadth — interaction design, visual polish, and clear thinking about why each decision was made.

• Domain knowledge is a strong advantage. This is a genuinely complex space — broking, F&O, market structure, the way regulation shapes every flow. If you've worked in trading, broking, or wealth, or you invest seriously yourself and understand it from the inside, that's a real head start. Not a hard requirement, but it counts for a lot.

• Comfort with complexity. You've designed for data-heavy or regulated products — fintech, trading, health, anything where the details are hard and the stakes are real. Or you can show us you'll get there fast.

• Systems thinking. You design with the whole product in mind, not one screen at a time. You're fluent with design systems and know when to extend one versus break from it.

• Strong written and verbal communication. You can write clear microcopy, make a tight argument for a direction, and give direct, useful feedback.

• Player-coach instinct. You're senior enough to lead and still want your hands on the work.

 What we care about 

 We hire and grow people around three things: craft, context, and community. 

• Craft — the quality of the work and the attention to detail behind it.

• Context — understanding the bigger picture: the user, the business, the system you're part of.

• Community — building the people and the relationships around the work, not just the work itself.

 We believe in subtractive design: the best version of a financial product usually has less in it, not more. We'd rather remove the right thing than add another feature. If that resonates, you'll like it here.

 Why this matters 

 Most Indians have never owned a stock. The ones who do often find investing intimidating, opaque, or built for someone more sophisticated than they feel. Getting this right means more people participating in the country's growth, with confidence and without getting burned. That's the work. 

 Design Microsite : https://design.phonepe.com/ 
 PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles) 

• Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance

• Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System

• Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program

• Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy

• Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment 

• Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

 Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. PhonePe is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally; regardless of gender, sexual preference, religion, race, color or disability. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or reasonable accommodation, during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please fill out this form.

 At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

 About Design at Gusto 

 Design at Gusto is made up of over 80 creative, collaborative people who care deeply about our mission to empower small businesses and their employees. We're a cross-functional group that is always looking for opportunities to build understanding and empathy for the people who use Gusto. We don't care much about swim lanes and though we care deeply about quality and craft, we are never precious about it. We work closely with cross-functional partners in Product, Engineering, Data, and Marketing to design, build, and ship experiences that make a real difference. We believe great design can make hard things possible, even delightful.

 We are building an AI-native design organization — and we mean that seriously. We're looking for designers who are already working this way: using AI to prototype ideas quickly, shorten customer feedback loops, and ship quality UX directly to customers. This isn't a future aspiration — it's how we work now, and it's changing what the design role looks like at Gusto and across the industry.

 About the Role: 

 Gusto's Unified Service Platform (USP) is the infrastructure behind how small businesses get help when it matters most — AI-driven support, multi-channel service, and the human expertise that steps in when AI isn't enough. We're looking for a Head of Design to lead the design team behind it and set the bar for what AI-native service design looks like at Gusto.

 This is a people-leadership role. You'll lead, coach, and grow a small, high-caliber team of three designers — spanning product design and conversation design — and you'll be accountable for the quality, direction, and delivery of design across the platform. You'll also be the design voice on the USP quartet, peer-to-peer with PM, Engineering, and Data leaders — authoring strategy in ambiguous spaces and spearheading cross-functional convergence. And it's a genuine player-coach role: alongside leading the team, you'll stay hands-on on the highest-leverage design work yourself.

 If you want to build and lead the team defining AI-native service design — at the exact moment the category is being invented — this is that role.

 About the Team: 

 The Unified Service Platform team builds the experiences that establish how Gusto customers get help — across self-service, in-product guidance, multi-channel support, and the AI and human experts behind all of it. You'll lead a team of three designers (product and conversation design) within a cross-functional group of engineers, PMs, and data partners, designing for both the small business owners who rely on Gusto and the experts who serve them. Design on USP is a strategic function — embedded in product direction from day one, not brought in at the execution stage.

 Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day: 

• Lead, coach, and grow a team of three designers (product + conversation design) — own their development, careers, performance, and craft growth, and create the conditions for them to do their best work.

• Own design direction and quality across USP — set the vision and the bar, and be accountable for the team's outcomes, not just its output.

• Stay hands-on where it matters most — as a player-coach, prototype and design the hardest flows and quartet-level artifacts yourself, not just review them; flex your hands-on time down as the team grows.

• Represent design on the USP quartet — co-lead product direction with PM, Engineering, and Data leaders; author strategy and POV in ambiguous spaces; drive convergence and close decisions.

• Set the standard for AI-native service design. This includes how trust, uncertainty, graceful failure, and AI-human handoffs show up on the platform. You will identify when AI outputs are ready to ship, when a human is needed, and when outputs should not be sent out at all.

• Guide service design end-to-end — journey mapping, blueprinting, and operational handoffs for a two-sided product — through your team.

• Champion an AI-native design practice — model and expect fluency with AI-native tools (Claude Code, Cursor, and comparable agentic tools) as part of the craft, and raise the floor for how the team designs.

• Partner on hiring and team building as the team grows.

 Here’s what we're looking for: 

• Experience managing and growing product designers — you've led a team, developed designers, run performance and growth, and built a healthy team culture. Managing across disciplines (e.g., content/conversation design alongside product design) is a well-developed plus.

• Design leadership in ambiguity — you set direction and a high craft bar, co-own strategy with cross-functional peers, and hold a position when the right answer is unpopular.

• AI-product judgment in consequential domains — you've shipped (or led teams that shipped) AI-mediated experiences in production, and can speak to uncertainty, errors, graceful failure, and human override.

• Service design depth — real journey mapping and blueprinting on two-sided products with operational handoffs, not workshop exercises.

• Hands-on AI fluency — you use AI-native tools yourself and can raise your team's fluency; you perceive AI as part of the craft, not separate from it.

• 12+ years of design experience , including 5+ years managing designers, with clear ownership of shipped work in a B2B SaaS environment.

 Responsibilities

• Challenge the status quo, push innovation, and inspire people toward a unified outcome

 Enablement: Lead internal cross-functional training enablement sessions for the practice and actively participate in internal discussion forums.

 Experience: 5+ years in software, professional services, or ERP consulting, with deep subject matter expertise in OTC (Order-to-Cash) or R2R (Record-to-Report) processes.

 Implementation Mastery: Proven track record of leading end-to-end customer SaaS or ERP implementations, driving projects through scoping, requirements gathering, UAT, and successful go-live.

 Financial & Systems Acumen: Strong understanding of accounting concepts (Receivables, Payables, Financial Close & Financial Consolidation Reporting). Experience with financial modules in major ERPs (SAP, Oracle Cloud, NetSuite, Workday, etc.) is highly preferred.

 Consulting & Communication Skills: Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and solution design skills. Highly capable of presenting to and facilitating sessions with both small and large executive stakeholder groups.

 Project Management: Proven capability to independently manage priorities across multiple concurrent projects and a complex stakeholder matrix.

jobs.title: Director, Product Design
jobs.description_text:
Role Description 

 Dropbox’s Design team is looking for a Director of Product Design to define the next generation of product experiences and infrastructure for Dropbox. In this role, you will lead the vision, strategy, and execution for the systems, patterns, and operating model that shape how Dropbox builds coherent, high quality, multi product experiences at scale. 

 We are building a modern system that can support a broader portfolio of products, accelerate product teams to achieve product market fit, improve front end quality, and create durable patterns for the most important product experiences across Dropbox. You will lead the team responsible for turning repeated product needs into reusable experience infrastructure: interaction patterns, product frameworks, design primitives, implementation standards, and adoption models that make it easier for teams to build excellent Dropbox experiences. 

 As Director, you will oversee the evolution of Dropbox’s design system into a next generation design and technology platform. This includes the foundational system of components, tokens, accessibility standards, and documentation, but also the broader lifecycle of product patterns: how they are identified, designed, validated, built, adopted, measured, improved, and eventually deprecated. You will help move the team from a reactive model, where design systems patternize work after the fact, to a more proactive model, where the team helps shape core product experiences from the beginning. 

 You will also establish Design Systems and Design Technology as a center of excellence for front end product quality. This team should not only define what good looks like, but help build it. That means partnering deeply with product designers, engineers, product managers, researchers, brand, and leadership to create high leverage patterns that improve product coherence, accelerate execution, and raise the quality bar across web, mobile, desktop, and emerging AI native experiences. 

 The ideal candidate is a systems minded design leader with excellent product judgment, strong craft standards, deep experience leading multidisciplinary teams, and the ability to operate across strategy, execution, governance, and organizational influence. You should be equally comfortable defining a long term vision for the future of design systems, reviewing the details of a complex interaction pattern, partnering with engineering on implementation quality, and helping senior leaders understand where the product experience needs stronger horizontal investment. 

 This is a critical leadership role for Dropbox’s multi product future. You will help define how shared product experiences are built, how teams adopt them, how quality scales, and how Dropbox creates a more coherent, intelligent, and durable product experience for customers. 

 Responsibilities 

• Define and drive the vision for Dropbox’s next generation design system, expanding it from a component library into a broader product experience platform for patterns, primitives, standards, and shared product logic. 

• Lead Design Systems and Design Technology as a center of excellence for front end product quality, interaction patterns, accessibility, implementation standards, and cross product experience coherence. 

• Build and evolve reusable product patterns that drive core Dropbox experiences, including navigation, creation flows, sharing, permissions, collaboration, onboarding, search, content activation, notifications, settings, admin workflows, and AI assisted experiences. 

• Move the team from reactive patternization to proactive product leadership, helping identify horizontal product needs early and shaping solutions that can scale across multiple Dropbox surfaces and teams. 

• Own the full lifecycle of shared patterns and components, including discovery, definition, design, prototyping, engineering partnership, adoption, measurement, maintenance, governance, and deprecation. 

• Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Brand, Marketing, and Design leadership to align on the highest impact horizontal opportunities and ensure shared systems directly support product strategy. 

• Raise the craft and quality bar across Dropbox by improving interaction design, visual quality, information architecture, accessibility, motion, content patterns, implementation fidelity, and front end consistency. 

• Create an operating model that makes adoption desirable rather than mandated, ensuring product teams see the system as a way to move faster, build better, and reduce duplicated effort. 

• Lead and develop a team of designers, design technologists, and systems specialists, creating clear ownership, strong critique practices, high standards, and a culture of pragmatic systems thinking. 

• Partner with engineering leadership to improve the relationship between design systems, code, product infrastructure, and front end delivery, ensuring that design intent is translated into high quality implementation. 

• Establish durable governance, measurement, and contribution models that help the system evolve continuously while maintaining quality, coherence, and accountability. 

• Help Dropbox prepare for AI native product experiences by defining systems that can encode design knowledge, guide product decisions, and support more adaptive, contextual, and intelligent experiences over time. 

 Requirements 

• 12+ years of product design, design systems, design technology, or front end experience, including significant experience leading complex systems or platform initiatives at scale. 

• 5+ years of people management experience, with a strong track record of leading senior designers, managers, design technologists, or multidisciplinary systems teams. 

• Deep experience building, scaling, or transforming design systems for complex multi product organizations. 

• Strong product judgment and the ability to connect systems work directly to customer value, product strategy, execution speed, and business impact. 

• Exceptional systems thinking, with the ability to see patterns across teams, products, platforms, and workflows, then turn those patterns into reusable experience infrastructure. 

• High craft standards across interaction design, information architecture, visual design, accessibility, prototyping, content patterns, motion, and implementation quality. 

• Proven ability to influence senior cross functional partners, create alignment across ambiguous problem spaces, and drive horizontal product quality without relying on mandate alone. 

• Strong technical fluency and comfort partnering with front end engineering teams on component architecture, implementation standards, platform constraints, quality control, and system adoption. 

• Experience defining governance models, contribution models, quality standards, documentation practices, and lifecycle processes for shared product systems. 

• A clear point of view on the future of design systems, including how AI, design technology, design infrastructure, and reusable product logic should change how teams design and build. 

• A collaborative, low ego leadership style, with a track record of developing talent, raising standards, improving critique, and helping teams produce better work than they could have produced on their own. 

• A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates strong design leadership, systems strategy, product impact, organizational influence, and excellent taste. 

 Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description_text:
About the Team 
 Miro is a canvas. Not metaphorically — literally: an infinite, multiplayer surface where millions of people think together, run workshops, map systems, and build things. The canvas is the product, and making it feel fast, fluid, and alive is at the heart of what we do.
 The Design Systems team sits at a critical leverage point in this mission. We define the foundations that allow the entire product organisation to build with consistency, quality, and speed — from components and tokens to patterns and tooling that shape how Miro feels across every surface.
 As AI changes how software is built, our design system is evolving too. We are building an AI-native system where generated code uses the right components, tokens, and patterns by default. But our ambition goes beyond compliance. A great design system does not just enforce rules — it encodes craft, taste, and the details that make an experience feel intentional.
 This is a craft-first, build-first role. You prototype in code because it is the most honest medium, you build the primitives that others ship on, and you help define the difference between something that works and something that feels truly great.
 About the Role 
 As a Staff Design Engineer, Design Systems, you will own the evolution of Miro’s design system as a foundation for product quality, scalability, and craft. You will shape how components, tokens, patterns, and AI-generated experiences come together to create a coherent and delightful user experience.
 You will work across the canvas and AI portfolio, partnering closely with product designers, engineers, and product managers to establish the standards, tools, and practices that help teams build better experiences faster.
 At this level, your impact goes beyond what you personally ship. You will raise the quality bar across the organisation by creating systems others can build on, mentoring teams, and turning design principles into scalable engineering practices.
 What you'll do 
 
• Own and evolve Miro’s design system foundations, including component architecture, token strategy, theming, and contribution models that keep the system coherent as the organisation scales.

• Define how AI-generated interfaces can be compliant by default, embedding design system patterns, accessibility standards, and quality checks into the development workflow.

• Go beyond functional consistency by encoding craft into the system — including visual hierarchy, motion, interaction patterns, and the details that make experiences feel distinctly Miro.

• Lead token strategy beyond colour and spacing, including motion, transitions, spatial behaviour, and real-time multiplayer states such as presence and cursors.

• Build canvas-grade primitives that support Miro’s real-time, multiplayer experience while maintaining performance and responsiveness across devices.

• Create patterns, tools, and frameworks that help designers and engineers move faster with confidence.

• Partner with teams across the Canvas and AI portfolio to solve complex interaction challenges and establish scalable solutions.

• Write, document, and teach — creating shared understanding and helping grow design engineering as a practice at Miro.

 What you'll need 
 
• Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, and modern frontend architecture, with strong opinions shaped by building and shipping products.

• Experience designing and building scalable design systems, component libraries, and governance models.

• Strong understanding of design principles and visual craft — including typography, spacing, alignment, colour, contrast, motion, and interaction details.

• A product mindset and strong design judgement: you can recognise the difference between something that works and something that feels right, and you can articulate why.

• Experience working with graphics and spatial technologies such as WebGL, Canvas API, SVG, and complex layout systems.

• Strong understanding of motion and interaction design, including animation principles, easing, timing, and performance considerations.

• Experience designing for real-time multiplayer experiences, including concepts such as presence, collaboration, and co-authorship.

• Experience building AI-powered experiences and understanding the unique UX challenges of probabilistic systems, including streaming, uncertainty, latency, and trust.

• Experience with AI development patterns such as structured outputs, streaming APIs, and designing reliable experiences around AI-generated content.

• The ability to prototype quickly in code — you reach for the browser when exploring ideas and use implementation as a way of thinking.

• Strong communication and influence skills, with the ability to mentor others, establish standards, and drive quality across teams.

 What's in it for you 
 
• Competitive equity package

• Lunch, snacks and drinks provided in the office

• Wellbeing benefit and WFH equipment allowance

• Annual learning and development allowance to grow your skills and career

• Opportunity to work for a globally diverse team

jobs.title: Staff UX Researcher, Incubations (Mixed Methods)
jobs.description_text:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

 NOTE: This position is US - Remote Eligible, but includes monthly in-person working sessions at the San Francisco Airbnb office. 

 The Community You Will Join: 

 Research has been part of Airbnb from the beginning, ever since Paul Graham told the Airbnb founders, "go to your users." As designers, the founders embraced this advice and got on a plane to meet with Airbnb hosts that very weekend. Since those early days, the value of research has been baked into Airbnb’s product culture.

 The Difference You Will Make: 

 We're building our newest incubation work stream, and we're looking for a Staff UX Researcher who is equally strong in qualitative and quantitative methods. You'll be one of the first researchers on the ground for a 0-to-1 effort, which means the questions aren't defined yet, the roadmap will change, and your research will shape both. You'll know when to run fast to unblock a decision and when to go deep to get it right, while bringing senior stakeholders along the way.

 A Typical Day: 

• Own end-to-end research for new incubation areas, from framing the questions to landing the recommendations.

• Utilize appropriate qualitative and quantitative methods to deliver fast, actionable insights. 

• Triangulate across data sources and past learnings to get to the right signals in an ambiguous, fast-moving space.

• Balance speed and rigor: deliver quick reads when the team needs to move, and deeper studies when a decision warrants it, without sacrificing quality.

• Partner closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Design, Business Operations, and Data Science to shape strategy from research insights.

• Communicate clearly and persuasively with stakeholders at every level, including senior executives.

• Develop compelling narratives that make users' needs, pain points, and opportunities impossible to ignore.

• Lead brainstorming sessions and workshops to translate research insights into product decision and strategy.

 Your Expertise: 

• 10+ years of research experience, with expertise in both qualitative and quantitative methods.

• Experience with AI tools for user research.

• Hands-on ability to run statistical analysis and design/analyze surveys, as well as lead foundational qualitative studies.

• A track record of delivering impactful insight in ambiguous, early-stage, or fast-changing problem spaces.

• Proven ability to work directly with senior leadership and influence strategy.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong multi-tasking skills to own multiple projects at different stages simultaneously.

 Bonus Expertise: 

• Experience on 0-to-1 or incubation products.

• Familiar with Claude Code.

• SQL and comfort working directly with data.

• Background in consumer products and/or hospitality.

• Degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science, Psychology, Statistics, or equivalent practical experience. (General guideline: strong researchers come from many backgrounds; please apply if you feel you'd be a good fit.) 

 Your Location: 

 This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role includes monthly in-person working sessions at the San Francisco Airbnb office and attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. 

 Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: 

 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. 

 We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process.  We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

 Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

jobs.title: (Junior) Designer / Motion Designer (m/w/d)
jobs.description_text:
Bei Speekly bauen wir Creatives, die echt wirken – authentischer UGC statt Hochglanz. Als Europas führende UGC-Plattform wächst unser Marketing über zwei Motoren: Paid und Organic. Für beide suchen wir dich: einen kreativen Kopf, der aus Rohmaterial und Konzepten Assets macht, die beim Scrollen stoppen.

Wir feilen nicht endlos am Einzelstück, sondern denken in Systemen und Wirkung. Wenn du lieber zehn Ads lieferst, die im Test gewinnen, als eine perfekte, die drei Wochen hängt – dann passt das hier. 💜

 Aufgaben

 Asset-Produktion 

Du produzierst Statics, Motion Graphics und Video-Ads, primär für Meta und TikTok sowie Assets für Social, Email, Blog und Website. Dabei setzt du auf verschiedene Formate, Stile und Angles statt auf einen Signature-Look. Größere Projekte entstehen gemeinsam mit dem Growth Manager.

 UGC-Editing 

Du schneidest Creator-Rohmaterial zu performanten Ads, mit Cutdowns, Untertiteln, starkem Pacing und Sound-Design. Konzept und Storyboard bekommst du vorgegeben – dein Job ist, das Beste herauszuholen.

 Vor & hinter der Kamera 

Du stehst regelmäßig selbst vor der Kamera und filmst auch andere. Dafür brauchst du kein Studio-Setup, aber ein gutes Auge für Bild, Licht und Ton. Authentizität steht für uns vor Hochglanz.

 Multi-Market-Produktion & Lokalisierung 

Du produzierst Varianten für mehrere Märkte (u. a. DE, NL, IT, UK, FR, ES) von Resizes bis zu Captions, Untertiteln und marktspezifischen Anpassungen. Übersetzungshilfe bekommst du von uns.

 Design-System & smarte Prozesse 

Du entwickelst unsere Templates und wiederverwendbaren Setups weiter, um Content effizient zu produzieren. Dabei hältst du unser Design-System konsistent und bringst eigene Ideen für unsere CI ein.

 Qualifikation

 Performance & Editing 

Du beherrschst performance-orientiertes Editing und weißt, wie starke Hooks, gutes Pacing und Retention zusammenspielen. Performance-Auswertungen musst du nicht selbst erstellen, kannst sie aber verstehen und in bessere Creatives übersetzen.

 Social-Media-native 

Du kennst relevante Formate, Trends und Ästhetiken und verstehst, was gerade funktioniert – und warum. Dieses Gespür übersetzt du in Creatives, die sich nativ statt nach Werbung anfühlen.

 Ownership & Zusammenarbeit 

Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und verlässlich, bringst eigene Ideen ein und gehst offen mit Feedback um. Auch bei mehreren Creatives und Märkten behältst du den Überblick.

 Tools & AI 

After Effects und Premiere Pro beherrschst du sicher, auch mit Figma arbeitest du souverän. AI-Tools wie Claude oder AI-Funktionen in Premiere und After Effects nutzt du, um effizienter zu arbeiten und Neues auszuprobieren – die Rolle dreht sich aber nicht um AI. Photoshop und Illustrator sind ein Plus.

 Erfahrung 

Idealerweise bringst du rund zwei Jahre Erfahrung in einem produktionsintensiven Umfeld mit echtem Kampagnen-Output mit. Agenturerfahrung ist ein Plus. Potenzial und Lernbereitschaft zählen bei uns aber genauso. Für deine tägliche Arbeit sowie die Kommunikation im Team bringst du sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse mit.

 Benefits

 Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung für deinen Bereich und hast den Freiraum, Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten.

 Teamspirit: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt. Bei uns arbeitest du auf Augenhöhe und kannst wirklich etwas bewegen.

 Hardware: Ob Mac oder Windows – du arbeitest mit der Hardware, die am besten zu dir passt.

 Urban Sports Club: Mit einer Mitgliedschaft unterstützen wir dich dabei, aktiv zu bleiben und einen Ausgleich zum Arbeitsalltag zu schaffen.

 Office-Life zum Wohlfühlen: Bei uns darf der Arbeitsalltag unkompliziert sein: Es gibt keinen Dresscode, mittags essen wir gerne gemeinsam und im Sommer gehört auch mal eine spontane Eis-Pause dazu. Auch dein Hund ist im Office herzlich willkommen.

 Erfolge feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder spontane Team-Events. Unsere Erfolge feiern wir am liebsten gemeinsam.

 🎬 Lust, mit uns Creatives zu bauen, die wirklich performen? 

 Dann wollen wir sehen, was du kannst! Schick uns deine Bewerbung zusammen mit deinem Portfolio oder Showreel (am besten als Link auf dem Lebenslauf oder Anschreiben). Bei einem visuellen Beruf wollen wir deine Skills direkt in Action sehen.

 ———

 Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung oder Identität. Chancengleichheit und ein respektvoller Umgang sind für uns selbstverständlich.

jobs.description_text:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 
 Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.
 Quality is our competitive advantage. Every member of our fully remote team is a maker at heart, caring deeply about the quality and feel of our work. While the industry optimizes for speed and metrics alone, we believe that craft and quality have lasting value. Quality creates gravity — it pulls people toward our team and product rather than requiring us to push. This philosophy drives everything we do, from product decisions to hiring choices.
 For this role, we expect robust design skills, sharp product thinking, and the ability to engage in technical discussions. We work in small, autonomous project teams, where engineers are paired tightly with designers to explore ideas, build prototypes, deploy internal builds, and ultimately ship to customers. You will be a key element of projects from beginning to end.
 Location & work mode 
 Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. 
 What you'll do 
 
• Pair closely with engineering and product to initiate and complete roadmap projects, no hand-offs

• Spot opportunities to redesign or refine key screens and flows, as well as smaller quality issues and “paper cuts” as you use Linear

• Create mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to communicate ideas and describe their execution

• Guide and inspire fellow designers through collaborative critique of work-in-progress

• Use and improve our lightweight design system components

• Help with hiring new teammates that can elevate our team and product

 What we’re looking for 
 
• 7+ years experience designing software

• Courage to ask questions, experiment, and advocate for what you feel is right

• Humility to accept feedback, adapt your thinking, and iterate toward the best solution

• Experience with prototyping in Figma (and beyond with tools like AI, HTML/CSS, Origami)

• Ability to distill problems and feedback, then design clear, focused solutions

• Effective written and verbal communication skills — much of our work is async

 What we offer 
 We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:
 
• Competitive salary and equity

• Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

• Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

• Paid co-working space or desk

• Health coverage (based on country requirements)

• 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

• 4 months paid parental leave

• Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

• Regular team events and off-sites

• Remote-first with no required commute

 Learn how we think and work 
 
• Part I and Part II of how we redesigned the Linear UI

• Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear 

• Read me a story about our mission 

• Why and how we do work trials Linear blog post 

• How we structure our product teams talk by our Head of Product, Nan Yu, at Config 2024 

• Crafting quality that endures Config keynote by our Co-founder & CEO, Karri Saarinen 

• Building for quality: Our Investment in Linear Accel Series B blog post 

 Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. 
 A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @ linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers . We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app .

At a time when space superiority can no longer be taken for granted and with space systems proliferating at an incredible rate, the Space Special Programs team provides advanced, mission critical capabilities to our customer base to be able to more effectively operate and survive within this expanding environment with limited personnel. Working across product, engineering, sales, logistics, operations, and mission success, the Space Special Programs team develops, tests, deploys, and operates new, unique, space capabilities to drive mission success in challenging operational environments.

Here you will work on core technologies, subsystems, spacecraft, and complete space systems supporting the Space Special Programs team and core mission. The primary function of this role is to be a highly experienced resource to help implement and influence the team’s development roadmap, be a resource for mentoring and growing the engineering team, and to be an individual contributor in both technical and strategic areas. The ideal candidate would be practical, hands-on and a self-starter, with significant experience designing, analyzing, building, and operating spacecraft mechanical, opto-mechanical, and both passive and active mechanisms – experience machining components is a significant plus. • Hands-on assembly, prototyping, testing, and performance characterization of mechanisms designed for 0g but in a 1g environment. 

• Experience designing and building very small mechanisms, components, and systems. 

• Familiarity with launch environments, testing for launch environments, range safety, and system integration efforts 

• Demonstrated creativity and “out of the box thinking” for spacecraft mechanisms with an eye toward simplicity and reliability 

• High competence with, and fluid use of, engineering first principles 

• Strong organizational skills 

• BS, MS or PhD in an engineering field, or equivalent work experience

• Ability to be pragmatic about problem solving

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

jobs.description_text:
About Mixpanel 

 Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .

 About the role

 At Mixpanel, we believe design excellence is a competitive moat. In a world where AI makes it easier than ever to ship, we believe the quality of the experience — how it feels, how it builds trust, how it handles complexity with grace — that separates good products from great ones.

 As a Staff Design Engineer at Mixpanel, you'll sit within the design organization and lead the transformation of our design system from a component library into something far more important: the infrastructure that powers how we design, build, and ship in an AI-native world. You'll encode our craft, standards, and vision directly into the systems, tools, and workflows that every designer, engineer, and AI agent in our org builds on.

 This isn't a maintenance or systems stewardship role. It's a transformative one. You'll work at the frontier of what design and engineering collaboration looks like when AI writes most of the code, agents prototype from intent, and the design system is less a library and more a living foundation for everything we ship.

 You'll be the designer who ships production code. The engineer who holds an uncompromising craft bar. The person who sees the future of how Mixpanel will look and behave in an AI-native world, and builds the infrastructure to make it real.

 What you'll do

 Build the infrastructure for an AI-native design practice

 Translate Mixpanel's design standards, principles, and taste into systems that live in the code. Build a token system, component library, documentation, and guidelines that AI agents, AI coding tools, and AI prototyping workflows can reliably build on. Evolve our design system to be foundational infrastructure for AI-assisted workflows.

 Shape how Mixpanel looks and behaves in an AI-native world

 Sit within the product design team and collaborate on reimagining Mixpanel for a world where interfaces are conversational, agentic, and adaptive. You have the rare combination of deep design sensibility and production engineering skills, and you’ll use both to help bring our AI product vision to life with craft and coherence that generic AI outputs can't match.

 Own the bridge between design and code

 Build systems that connect design to code and keep the two in sync. Define what "shippable" looks like as AI writes more of the code. Work directly in the codebase. Ship PRs that improve the product. Make design a force multiplier for engineering, not a bottleneck.

 Stand up prototyping and AI tooling infrastructure

 Build the workflows, tools, and infrastructure that let designers and PMs prototype at high fidelity, with working code, real components, and interactive states, without waiting on engineering. Identify the places where design and engineering lose time, intent, or quality in the handoff, and build AI-powered workflows that close those gaps.

 Set and model the craft bar

 Establish what great looks like — not through documentation alone, but through the quality of what you ship. Enable designers to work more code-adjacent and engineers to build with better components. Stay ahead of how AI is changing EPD workflows and bring that change into the org responsibly.

 What success looks like

• The design system is a reliable foundation that AI tools and agents build on, not an obstacle they work around

• Design and code are in sync; the gap between what's designed and what ships is closed

• Designers can prototype at high fidelity without waiting on engineering

• Engineers spend less time on UI polish and rework, more time on features

• The Mixpanel product feels unmistakably itself — cohesive, expressive, and craft-forward — as it evolves into an AI-native experience

• The org is enabled on the latest AI-assisted design and development workflows

 Qualifications

• Proficiency in modern front-end frameworks: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, Next.js

• Experience with design systems. Ideally you've built or overhauled one at scale

• Strong design sensibility: you care about craft, consistency, interaction quality, and taste

• Fluency in AI-assisted workflows: canvas-to-code, code-to-canvas, AI prototyping tools, MCP integrations, and what's emerging in this space

• Experience working with tools like Figma, Storybook, VSCode, Chromatic, and GitHub

• A track record of working across design and engineering: you've done both, and you know how to collaborate across both

• Comfortable operating with high autonomy: you set direction, influence standards, and manage complex projects without a lot of hand-holding

• 8+ years in design engineering, UX engineering, design technology, or a related hybrid role

 Bonus points

• Experience designing or building data visualizations

• Background in brand and/or product design

• Experience with accessibility: WCAG 2.2, ARIA patterns, semantic HTML, APCA, accessible data viz

• Experience working in a product analytics or developer-focused product environment

 Compensation 

 The amount listed below is the total target cash compensation (TTCC) and includes base compensation and variable compensation in the form of either a company bonus or commissions. Variable compensation type is determined by your role and level. In addition to the cash compensation provided, this position is also eligible for equity consideration and other benefits including medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage. You can view our benefits offerings here .

Our salary ranges are determined by role and level and are benchmarked to the SF Bay Area Technology data cut released by Radford, a global compensation database. The range displayed represents the minimum and maximum TTCC for new hire salaries for the position across all of our US locations. To stay on top of market conditions, we refresh our salary ranges twice a year so these ranges may change in the future. Within the range, individual pay is determined by experience, job-related skills, qualifications, and other factors. If you have questions about the specific range, your recruiter can share this information. 

 Mixpanel Compensation Range
 $236,000 — $300,000 USD 

 Benefits and Perks 

• Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care

• Mental Wellness Benefit

• Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays

• Enhanced Parental Leave

• Volunteer Time Off

• Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

 *please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary* 

 Culture Values 

• Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.

• Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.

• One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.

• Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.

• Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.

• Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

 Why choose Mixpanel? 

 We’re a leader in analytics with over 9,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

 Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

 Minimum requirements for the role: 

• 12+ years of experience shipping hardware programs at scale in partnership with partners overseas

• Proven record navigating tradeoffs between design, manufacturability, schedule, and cost in a cross-functional environment

• Experience developing and launching electromechanical components or products in mass production 

• Demonstrated experience designing for automotive, outdoor, industrial, or consumer products

• Proficiency in plastic/metal part design, CAD modeling, and drafting, preferably using NX

• BS degree in mechanical engineering or related field

• Ability to travel up to 10% (domestic and international) when necessary

 An ideal candidate also has: 

• 15+ years of experience shipping high-volume hardware programs at scale

• MS degree in mechanical engineering or related field

• Experience shipping products with JDM partner teams in a leveraged development model

• Experience with ruggedized product design, including IP sealing, vibration, and harsh environments

• Experience integrating camera and antenna technologies in smart product, vehicle, or equipment applications

• Significant hands-on experience working with customer feedback to make better product decisions

Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. 

 Annual Base Salary
 $220,000 — $275,000 USD 

 Total Rewards 

 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

 Flexible Working 

 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

 Belonging at Samsara 

 At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

 Accommodations

 Our Commitment to Authenticity

In 1954, Eero Saarinen designed a branch office with glass walls, no offices, and a completely open floor plan in Columbus, Indiana. It was surrounded by trees; the furniture was made by Herman Miller; the lobby flooring was thick, rustic brick. It was built with transparency and community at its core. Since then, a lot of things have happened — Saarinen's branch is now a conference center, people increasingly live on the internet, and it's hard to think of a single financial institution that still applies design thinking to their company.

 Mercury is on a mission to defy those expectations. We're a financial technology company that helps startups spend less time banking* and more time building. We believe that the key to our success revolves around thoughtful design — and we hold the craft of that design to an exceptionally high standard. We're looking for a Staff Brand Designer who sets that bar: someone whose eye is so precise, and whose execution is so considered, that the work around them gets better just by virtue of their presence.

 This is a role for a designer who sweats the details that most people don't notice — the type hierarchy, the negative space, the grid, the crop. Someone who has developed a genuine aesthetic philosophy over years of doing hard work at a high level, and who brings that philosophy to everything they touch. You'll own the most technically complex brand design work at Mercury, provide craft oversight across the Brand Studio, and help define what visual excellence looks like as our brand continues to evolve.

 * Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC. 

 In this role, you’ll:

• Set and uphold the craft standard for Mercury's brand — across campaigns, web, social, events, and every surface the brand touches.

• Lead the most technically complex and high-visibility brand design projects end-to-end, from brief through delivery.

• Partner with a staff-level brand designer and creative leadership to co-lead the evolution of Mercury's creative direction — defining and executing visual standards across typography, imagery, layout, and motion.

• Provide hands-on craft oversight across Brand Studio output — reviewing work, raising the quality floor, and helping the team make better decisions.

• Commission and art-direct external creatives: photographers, illustrators, and motion designers.

• Develop brand system documentation and decision-making frameworks that help the team move with confidence and consistency.

• Mentor IC3 and IC4 designers through critique, pairing, and direct feedback — elevating their craft through the work, not just in conversation.

• Collaborate with brand strategists, copywriters, PMMs, and leadership on how Mercury shows up across all channels.

• Shape how Brand Studio uses AI in its craft. You’ll set the standard for where AI belongs in the creative process, build AI-ready brand guidelines the team can design against, and hold the quality bar as these tools become part of how work gets made.

 What you’ll bring:

• A portfolio that is simply excellent — work that demonstrates mastery of typography, layout, color, and composition across a range of brand contexts.

• A clear and deeply held aesthetic point of view: you can articulate what makes something great and what makes something fall short, and you've built that perspective through years of rigorous practice.

• Fluency in brand systems — you understand how to build for scale and consistency, and you've stewarded a brand through growth or change.

• 7–10+ years of brand design experience, with a background that includes high-craft environments: agency, fashion, elevated consumer, or design-forward tech.

• Experience operating at a staff level: you work autonomously, influence without authority, and make decisions that shape the output of an entire team.

• Proficiency in Figma and hands-on experience contributing to or owning a design system.

• Strong verbal and presentation skills — you can communicate the process, intent, and impact of your design decisions with clarity.

• The judgment to know when to zoom in and when to zoom out, and the discipline to hold both at once.

• A considered point of view on AI’s place in high-craft design. You’ve used AI tooling in real creative work and can guide a team on where it belongs and how to use it without lowering the bar.

• Curiosity, restraint, and a genuine passion for doing work that's worth doing.

Since those early days, the value of research has been baked into Airbnb’s product culture.

 With over 5 million hosts and 2 billion global arrivals, payments are crucial to the experience. Every time a guest books or a host gets paid across 190 countries, they rely on a seamless system. When it works, it drives loyalty; when it fails, it costs bookings—making research in this space critical to our business and our mission of belonging.

In this mixed-methods role, you will combine behavioral insights with quantitative data to navigate ambiguity and global complexity. • Own end-to-end guest payments research, effectively prioritize research across multiple workstreams, plan and execute both foundational and evaluative research that shapes strategy and sharpens payments product experiences.

• Balance speed and rigor: deliver quick reads when the team needs to move, and deeper studies when a decision warrants it, without sacrificing quality.

• Mixed methods storytelling: Triangulate qualitative and quantitative data to understand the payments experience, distilling complex insights into clear, actionable narratives. Communicate clearly and persuasively with stakeholders at every level, including senior executives. 

• Partner closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Design, Business Operations, and Data Science to shape strategy from research insights.

• Facilitate brainstorming and workshops to drive research-backed product decisions, with flexibility to travel to the San Francisco office for key in-person collaborations.

 Your Expertise: 

• 10+ years of research experience, with deep expertise in both qualitative and quantitative methods.

• Demonstrated mastery of mixed-methods research- the ability to design, run, and integrate both quantitative and qualitative studies to answer strategic questions.

• Experience with payments, fintech, or other high-trust financial, high-complexity domains.

• A track record of influencing product and executive stakeholders with clear, compelling storytelling.

• Strong multi-tasking skills and project management skills to own multiple projects at different stages simultaneously and research efficiency.

• Effective at leading workshops and brainstorms with stakeholders.

• This role requires regular travel to the San Francisco Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. 

 Your Location: 

 This role is hybrid and will require the candidate to be based in San Francisco Bay area. The successful candidate will be expected to work from the San Francisco office at least 2-3 days per week.

 Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: 

 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

 Brex is looking for a Staff brand designer to join the Design team, a cross-disciplinary group of creatives including product designers, brand designers, content design, operations, and marketing strategists. Our team’s mission is to build a category-defining brand and meaningfully move key business metrics by delivering world-class creative. 

 Your role will be to drive the evolution of Brex's brand identity system, pushing our visual language forward while maintaining cohesion across all touch points. You'll be instrumental in defining how our brand shows up in the world, from establishing new design patterns and brand expressions to reimagining our visual identity for the next phase of growth. This is a strategic and hands-on role that will require you to work closely with Marketing leaders, Web and Product teams, and creative partners to ensure our brand identity is distinctive, scalable, and reflects our ambition. You are a systems thinker who can envision the big picture while obsessing over the craft details that bring a brand to life.

 Where you’ll work 

This role will be based in our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

 Responsibilities 

• Own and evolve Brex’s brand identity system, including visual language, typography, color, illustration, and brand patterns

• Define and maintain brand standards that balance consistency with creative flexibility across teams and channels

• Translate company strategy and brand vision into clear, compelling visual direction in partnership with leadership

• Design and deliver new brand expressions that advance the identity while preserving recognition and equity

• Lead high-impact brand work beyond the core system, including special campaigns, sub-brands, and select product or service launches

• Art direct and contribute to brand campaigns, collaborating with external partners and internal teams to ensure exceptional craft

• Provide guidance and feedback across the organization to raise the quality and effectiveness of brand execution

 Requirements 

• 7+ years of experience in brand design or art direction, with a strong focus on identity systems and brand evolution

• A portfolio demonstrating strategic thinking, system design, and high-quality execution across identities and campaigns

• Deep expertise in typography, color, composition, and building scalable visual systems

• Strong ability to articulate design decisions and build alignment with cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders

• Experience working across multiple workstreams in fast-paced, evolving environments

• Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, with comfort prototyping and iterating quickly

• Practical experience using AI tools in the creative process with sound judgment on when and how to apply them

 Bonus points 

• Motion, video, or illustration experience applied to brand systems or campaigns

• Experience art directing complex brand work with external creative partners

 Compensation 

 The expected salary range for this role is $187,000 - $234,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.
 Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Creative Director, Marketing
jobs.description_text:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

 At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

 Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world. 

 Read our blog to learn more.

 About the role... 

 We’re looking for a Senior Creative Director to set the creative vision for Duolingo’s brand building and marketing efforts and lead a team that delivers culturally resonant, high‑impact work across campaigns, social, partnerships, and user acquisition. You will raise the creative bar, turn bold ideas into clear concepts, and guide execution from brief through launch—collaborating closely with Brand Marketing and Growth, International Marketing, Product, Design, BD, and global agency partners to build an iconic brand with measurable business impact. Reporting to the CMO, this role will lead other creative leaders in the Marketing function.

 🧠 You will... 

• Drive all creative work in the Marketing function, ensuring it consistently ladders up to the company strategy and moves key brand and business metrics.

• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of creatives; set a high bar for craft, narrative, and taste while creating space for diverse voices and experimentation.

• Turn great ideas into end‑to‑end campaign concepts; guide direction across channels (social, video, experiential, partnerships), from insight to execution.

• Partner with Brand Marketing to shape briefs, make strategic trade‑offs, and deliver work that’s part of culture and drives brand love and growth.

• Partner with Growth Marketing to build a performance marketing creative studio enabling our user acquisition efforts across the globe. 

• Partner with our Country Marketing team to lead and evolve our global agency roster; ensure scopes, standards, and handoffs produce A+ creative worldwide.

• Oversee creative feedback and quality across all project stages; provide clear, timely decisions that keep momentum without sacrificing excellence.

• Inspire the organization with industry trends, creative references, and new platforms; codify what’s “on‑brand” and how we measure brand success.

 ✅ You have... 

• Experience in brand/creative roles with significant time leading other creative leaders; proven success shipping integrated campaigns across a wide range of budgets at a high bar.

• Demonstrated ability to set vision, influence senior stakeholders, and connect creative decisions to strategy, KPIs, and ROI.

• A track record of turning insights into iconic, culture‑driving ideas and guiding multi‑disciplinary teams from concept to launch.

• Excellent communication and feedback skills; you simplify complex topics, make fast, sound calls, and bring others along.

• Experience managing agencies and external partners across markets, with a reputation for raising quality and speed.

• The ability to work from or relocate to New York City or London, UK

 ⭐ Exceptional candidates will have...

• Experience working with IP-led brands

• Global brand experience, including creative leadership across multiple regions and cultures.

• A portfolio demonstrating world‑class craft and storytelling— work that drives buzz and earned media attention instead of relying on paid channels for distribution.

• Deep familiarity with social media and creator ecosystems, and how to translate cultural signals into breakthrough brand ideas.

• Experience establishing clear creative operating mechanisms with marketing, product, and design partners.

 The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role! 

 Salary Range: 
 £124,395 — £186,592 GBP 

 Benefits: Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits here .

 Job Alerts: Sign up for job alerts here .

 Accommodations: We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com .

 Equal Employment Opportunity: Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

 Fraud Warning: Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Duolingo and our employees will never ask for your Social Security number, bank details, or passport info, and we’ll never ask you to deposit a check, purchase equipment, or exchange money during the interview process. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double-check these details before sharing any information.

By applying for this position your data will be processed as per the Duolingo Applicant Privacy Notice .
